highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.0 previews Skia m155 and HarfBuzz 14.4.0, with RAW decoding retired.

breaking.title: Use a separate RAW or DNG decoder
breaking.body: Built-in RAW/DNG development and PIEX extraction of embedded JPEG previews are disabled; no replacement decoder is included. Decode those containers with another library and pass supported pixels or images to SkiaSharp. SKEncodedImageFormat.Dng remains value 10 for compatibility but no longer indicates decoding support. Standalone JPEG decoding is unchanged.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to m155 while preserving the rotation-scale text-run bounds contract and the existing managed binding surface.

Updates the native shaping engine with intentional cross-direction mark-positioning changes, glyph-position saturation, malformed-font fixes, and shaping and subsetting improvements. Adds OpenTypeBitsTag and OpenTypeNumberTag enums; raw fetch functions remain internal.

Drops uniquely held Ganesh cache entries after failed flushes and checks family acceptability only on the first valid sorted FontConfig candidate, allowing the caller to try the next requested family.

preview_summaries.v4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8: Corrected Ganesh cache cleanup after failed flushes and FontConfig first-candidate matching.
preview_summaries.v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13: Updated native HarfBuzz to 14.4.0 and added OpenType tag enums. Retired built-in RAW/DNG decoding without removing the public format enum.
preview_summaries.v4.155.0-preview.1.26471.14: Opened the Skia m155 line without changing the managed binding surface or rotation-scale text-run bounds contract.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates native HarfBuzz to 14.4.0 with intentional mark-positioning changes and malformed-font fixes. Adds OpenTypeBitsTag and OpenTypeNumberTag enums while keeping raw fetch functions internal.

v4.155.0-preview.1.26471.14.headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.0 previews the Skia m155 engine.
v4.155.0-preview.1.26471.14.body: The managed binding surface and explicit rotation-scale text-run bounds contract are preserved.

v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13.headline: This preview updates HarfBuzz to 14.4.0 and retires built-in RAW decoding.
v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13.body: It adds OpenType tag enums and includes intentional mark-positioning changes. Decode RAW and DNG containers with another library; the Dng enum remains available.

v4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8.headline: This release candidate corrects failed-flush caches and FontConfig matching.
v4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8.body: Ganesh drops uniquely held cache entries after failed rendering. FontConfig checks family acceptability only on the first valid sorted candidate so the caller can try its next requested family.
